lines.japanese: 「羽田ー」
lines.english: “Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「あんさー、担任がプリント集めて職員室持ってこいッつってたから。ヨロー」
lines.english: “Homeroom teacher said to collect the handouts and bring ’em to the faculty room. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: どの俺が返事をしますか？
lines.english: Which of us will answer?

lines.japanese: 「え……でもそれは高内さんが頼まれた用なんじゃ……」
lines.english: “Um... But weren’t you the one asked to do that, Takauchi?”

lines.japanese: 「馬ッ鹿おまえ、そんなんたまたま私が近くにいたってだけで、べつに学級委員ならどっちでもいいんだよ」
lines.english: “Don’t be stupid. I only got asked ’cause I happened to be standing nearby. Either class rep can do it.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうなんだ」
lines.english: “Oh. I see.”

lines.japanese: 「そんじゃ頼んだわ。そーゆーことで」
lines.english: “Great. I’m counting on you. Later.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、待って高内さん。ちょっとお願いがあるんだけど」
lines.english: “Wait, Takauchi. I have a favor to ask.”

lines.japanese: 「んだよ、なんか文句あんの？　あんなら私じゃなくて、チョクで担任に言ってくんない？」
lines.english: “What, you got a complaint? Take it straight to the teacher instead of bothering me.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、それはやっとくよ。そうじゃなくて、ちょっと別の頼みがあるんだ」
lines.english: “No, I’ll take care of the handouts. It’s a different favor.”

lines.japanese: 「無理」
lines.english: “No.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 話すら聞いてもらえず、僕はひとり取りのこされた。
lines.english: She left me standing there without even hearing me out.
“...What?”

lines.japanese: え、俺っ？
lines.english: Wait, me?

lines.japanese: ええー、俺このひと苦手なんすよねえ。
lines.english: Oh, come on. I don’t deal well with this woman.

lines.japanese: 「あのう、ちょっとお尋ねしますが、それはアナタ──高内さんが頼まれた用事なのでは？」
lines.english: “Excuse me, but wasn’t that the errand you—Takauchi—were asked to perform?”

lines.japanese: 「馬ッ鹿おまえ、そんなんたまたま私が近くにいたってだけで、学級委員ならどっちでもいいんだよ」
lines.english: “Don’t be stupid. I only got asked ’cause I happened to be standing nearby. Either class rep can do it.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はあ、なるほど」
lines.english: “Uh-huh. I see.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、どっちでもいいんだったら、頼まれた方が担うべきなのでは……」
lines.english: “But if either of us can do it, wouldn’t it make more sense for the one who was asked to handle it...?”

lines.japanese: ぬるぬる潤滑油としては、いらん波風立てずにハイハイ従うべきなんでしょう。
lines.english: As Slippery Shuusuke, the human lubricant, I should have nodded along without making unnecessary waves.

lines.japanese: しかし道化のイーグルはそこまで出来た人間じゃありません。どこぞの人格者のように、明らかな理不尽を頬笑みひとつで受けとめるなんて、いやいや、無理です無理です。
lines.english: But Eagle the clown was not that mature. Unlike a certain saintly personality, I could not greet blatant unfairness with a single serene smile. No, no. Impossible.

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なにおまえ、私の頼みが聞けないっつーの」
lines.english: “What? You saying you won’t do me a favor?”

lines.japanese: それは頼みじゃなくて脅迫というんですよ、昌子さん。
lines.english: That was called a threat, not a favor, Masako.

lines.japanese: 「いえ、なにか止むに止まれぬ事情があるんでしたら、もちろんお手伝いいたしますけど……」
lines.english: “No. If there are circumstances beyond your control, of course I’ll help...”

lines.japanese: 「ハア？　ありえね羽田、どんだけ冷てーんだよ。事情とかじゃなくて、おまえ男だろ。かよえー女子がこんだけ頭下げてんだから、ちょれーつって軽く引きうけとけよ」
lines.english: “What the hell, Haneda? How can you be this cold? Forget circumstances. You’re a man, aren’t you? A delicate little lady is bowing her head to you, so say, ‘Easy,’ and do it.”

lines.japanese: 「えっと……頭、下げましたっけ？」
lines.english: “Um... Did you bow your head?”

lines.japanese: 「ねえわ。羽田に頭下げるぐれーなら自分でやった方がマシだわ」
lines.english: “Hell no. I’d rather do it myself than bow to you.”

lines.japanese: 言ってることメチャクチャだ！
lines.english: Nothing she said made sense!

lines.japanese: 「それじゃあ……やります？　ご自分で……」
lines.english: “Then... will you do it yourself...?”

lines.japanese: 「チッ、かわいくねー」
lines.english: “Tch. You’re no fun.”

lines.japanese: 昌子さんは舌打ちを残してずんずん教壇へ向かわれました。
lines.english: Masako left a click of her tongue behind and marched to the teacher’s podium.

lines.japanese: 「おー、みんな注目ー。今日提出のプリント、私ンとこ持ってきてー」
lines.english: “Okay, listen up. Bring me the handouts due today.”

lines.japanese: クラスメイトたちが席を立ってわらわら寄ってくる中、彼女は露骨に不機嫌な眼光でちくちく俺の体を突きさすのでした。
lines.english: As our classmates rose and crowded around her, she shot prickly beams of open displeasure straight through my body.

lines.japanese: あーあ、間違っても彼女に署名を頼めるような空気ではなくなってしまいました。
lines.english: Well, I had certainly destroyed any chance of asking her for a signature.

lines.japanese: 「勝負に勝って試合に負けた……」
lines.english: “I won the battle and lost the war...”

lines.japanese: 俺かよ。
lines.english: You picked me?

lines.japanese: ヘコたれないタカシでも交渉役の鷲介でもなく、この俺を選んだってことは……そういうことだよな？
lines.english: You passed over unflappable Takashi and Shuusuke the negotiator to choose me... That means what I think it means, right?

lines.japanese: 相手を敵と認識したってことでいいんだよな？
lines.english: I can treat her as an enemy, right?

lines.japanese: 了解。
lines.english: Understood.

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　プリント集めろ？」
lines.english: “The fuck? Collect the handouts?”

lines.japanese: 俺は髪をかきあげ、ことさらに眼光を強調した。
lines.english: I swept back my hair, making a show of the glare in my eyes.

lines.japanese: 「なんで俺がやんだよ、めんどくせえ。そらテメエが頼まれた用だろ、俺がテメエのケツ拭いてやる義理なんざねーよ」
lines.english: “Why the fuck should I? It’s a pain in the ass. You’re the one who got asked. I got no obligation to wipe your ass for you.”

lines.japanese: 「ハじゃねーよ、ハイだろ。ふざけたことぬかしてッと、頭つかんでブン回すぞこのクソアマ」
lines.english: “Not ‘huh.’ ‘Uh-huh.’ Keep talking shit and I’ll grab you by the head and swing you around, bitch.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、言うじゃん」
lines.english: “Ha! Listen to you.”

lines.japanese: 女は不敵に微笑んだ。
lines.english: The woman smiled fearlessly.

lines.japanese: 「おもしれー。羽田のそういうカオ、久しぶりに見たわ。まァー、最近はすっかり猫かぶっちゃってェ？　でもやっとメッキが剥がれたっつーこと──」
lines.english: “This is interesting. Been a while since I saw that face, Haneda. You’ve really been playing nice lately, huh? Guess the cheap plating finally peeled off—”

lines.japanese: 「うーるせ喋ってンじゃねえよ、聞いてねンだよ。そんなことより、あのコレ、ちょっと。ちょっと書いて」
lines.english: “Shut up. I ain’t listening to you talk. More importantly, here. Write on this.”

lines.japanese: 俺は署名用紙を突きだして、強引に受けとらせた。
lines.english: I thrust the petition at her and forced it into her hands.

lines.japanese: 「あん？　んだコレ。署名？」
lines.english: “Huh? What’s this, a petition?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、いろいろあって。悪りんだけど、ソレに名前書いてくんない」
lines.english: “Yeah, stuff happened. Sorry, but can you put your name on it?”

lines.japanese: 「ハア～？　意味わかんね、そんな、いきなり名前とか言われたって──」
lines.english: “What the hell? That makes no sense. You can’t just walk up and ask for my name out of nowhere—”
“—My name?”

lines.japanese: 「あぁ、ああ……なに、そーゆーアレ？　名前とか言っちゃって、ハッ、ハハ、ちょっと図々しくねえ、おまえ」
lines.english: “Oh. Ohhh... Is that what this is? Asking for my name, huh? Ha-ha. Aren’t you getting a little forward?”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、黙って書けよ。おまえは黙って俺の言うこと聞いてりゃいいんだよ」
lines.english: “Shut up and write. All you gotta do is keep quiet and do what I say.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ……いいじゃん」
lines.english: “Huh... Not bad.”

lines.japanese: 「なにが」
lines.english: “What isn’t?”

lines.japanese: 「べつに」
lines.english: “Nothing.”

lines.japanese: やつは手近の机に転がっていたペンを拾って、ごちゃごちゃと書きはじめた。
lines.english: She grabbed a pen lying on the nearest desk and began scribbling something down.

lines.japanese: 「ハ～ア、署名のふりなんかしちゃってさあ。っとに、男ってめんどくせぇんだから……ほらよ」
lines.english: “Sigh. Pretending it’s a petition and everything. Men are such a pain in the ass... Here.”

lines.japanese: そして紙とペンを俺に放って去る。
lines.english: Then she tossed the paper and pen at me and walked away.

lines.japanese: しかし一度立ちどまった。
lines.english: But she stopped for a moment.

lines.japanese: 「羽田。やっぱアンタ、そっちのがハマッてるよ」
lines.english: “Haneda. You know, that personality suits you better.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「キモいキャラとか作ってねーで、ずっと素でいりゃ良かったのに」
lines.english: “Should’ve stayed yourself all along instead of making up that creepy character.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、卒業しても、気が向いたらかけてきなよ」
lines.english: “Anyway, even after we graduate, call me if you feel like it.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ、ありゃ……」
lines.english: “What the hell was that...?”

lines.japanese: 「おー、みんな注目ー。今日提出のプリント、私ンとこ持ってきてー」
lines.english: “Okay, listen up. Bring me the handouts due today.”

lines.japanese: 女は教壇へ上がって自分の仕事を始めた。そうだよ、そんぐれえテメエで最初からやっとけよ。
lines.english: The woman climbed onto the podium and started doing her own damn job. Yeah. You should’ve handled that much yourself from the start.

lines.japanese: 俺は舌先で頬の裏を突きながら、返ってきた署名用紙に目を落とす。
lines.english: I prodded the inside of my cheek with my tongue and looked down at the petition she had returned.

lines.japanese: ガキっぽい丸文字で高内昌子とあった。ハートやら星やらで派手にデコられてる。おまけに名前の横には、０９０で始まる１１桁の数字が記してあった。
lines.english: In childish, rounded handwriting, it said *Masako Takauchi*. She had decorated it lavishly with hearts and stars. Worse, beside her name she had written an eleven-digit number beginning with 090.

lines.japanese: 「盛んな。余計なモン盛んな」
lines.english: “Quit adding shit. Nobody asked for extras.”

lines.japanese: 俺は黒の油性ペンで、その邪魔な暗号をソッコー塗りつぶした。
lines.english: I immediately blacked out the intrusive code with a permanent marker.
